coverage_rule: Include every named individual dramatic figure directly named in Disney+'s Episode 1 opening premise/associated official opening series description: Luz, Eda, and King. Witches, demons, species, portals, magic, the Owl House, schools, covens, artifacts, places, realms, and later relationships are terms/context rather than independent character nodes. The source directly calls Luz a teenage human girl, Eda a witch, and King a tiny warrior; it does not provide surnames, demon identity, magic mechanics, other named characters, or later characterization.

uncertainties: Disney+ explicitly calls Luz a teenage human girl; no numerical age is assigned. This source contains no child-safety event, school/family conflict detail, or age rating-to-character inference.

Disney+ calls Eda a rebellious witch and King an adorably tiny warrior. It does not call King a demon or give either individual a species taxonomy, disability, cultural identity, magical capability, or moral alignment; none is inferred.

Disney+ says Luz befriends Eda and King in the opening description. This supports a premise-level friendship relation only, not later household/found-family, mentorship, romance, identity, or consent claims.
Portal, magical-world, witch, and demon-adjacent language are fictional animation terms. No real religious, occult, medical, body-horror, or identity claim is made.
evidence_basis: Official Disney+ series/episode metadata only. The primary episode locator supplies the S1E1 title and portal premise; the same official page’s opening series description supplies the named Luz/Eda/King encounter framing. No later or non-official source is used.
